registers.name: CTRL_EN
registers.description: Control register. Bit 0 enables the controller, bit 1 is a write-1 clear_faults pulse, bits [3:2] program operating_mode, and bits [31:4] are reserved.

fields.name: ENABLE
fields.description: Global controller enable. When 0, transport and actuator behavior remain in safe fallback policy.

fields.name: CLEAR_FAULTS
fields.description: Write-1 pulse to request clearing sticky fault bits when active fault conditions are absent.

fields.name: OPERATING_MODE
fields.description: Two-bit operating mode selector used by response validation and request formatting. Unsupported values may assert configuration/parser fault behavior.

registers.name: STREAM_VEL_SETPOINT
registers.description: Compact stream velocity setpoint and request metadata programming.

fields.name: STREAM_VELOCITY_SETPOINT
fields.description: 16-bit compact velocity setpoint used in outbound request metadata.

registers.name: TIMEOUT_CYCLES
registers.description: Watchdog timeout programming in clock cycles.

fields.name: TIMEOUT_CYCLES
fields.description: Maximum number of clk cycles permitted between request acceptance and valid response before watchdog expiry.

registers.name: STALE_AGE_LIMIT
registers.description: Maximum acceptable response age before stale rejection.

fields.name: STALE_AGE_LIMIT
fields.description: Maximum permitted response age. Responses older than this limit are rejected as stale.

registers.name: ACTUATOR_MIN
registers.description: Lower bound for clamped actuator command.

fields.name: ACTUATOR_MIN
fields.description: Minimum allowed actuator command after clamping.

registers.name: ACTUATOR_MAX
registers.description: Upper bound for clamped actuator command.

fields.name: ACTUATOR_MAX
fields.description: Maximum allowed actuator command after clamping.

fields.name: FALLBACK_COMMAND
fields.description: Command driven in safe fallback state and on invalid or missing validated response.

registers.name: LAST_TXN_ID
registers.description: Last accepted request transaction ID and status mirror.

fields.name: LAST_TXN_ID
fields.description: Transaction ID captured on the last accepted outbound request.

registers.name: LAST_RXN_ID
registers.description: Last accepted response transaction ID and status mirror.

fields.name: LAST_RXN_ID
fields.description: Transaction ID captured on the last validated inbound response.

registers.name: STATUS_FAULTS
registers.description: Sticky and live status bits for diagnostics.

fields.name: STICKY_FAULT_STATUS
fields.description: Sticky fault indicator that remains asserted until cleared while fault-free.

fields.name: REQUEST_PENDING
fields.description: Outstanding request is pending a valid response.

fields.name: WATCHDOG_EXPIRED
fields.description: Watchdog timeout has occurred for the current or last outstanding request.

fields.name: CLAMP_ACTIVE
fields.description: Actuator output was clamped to programmed bounds.

fields.name: FALLBACK_ACTIVE
fields.description: Safe fallback command is currently active.

fields.name: PARSER_ERROR
fields.description: Parser or response legality error detected.

registers.name: COUNTER_LAST_TXN_MIRROR
registers.description: Optional readback mirror of last transaction ID for software convenience; identical semantics to LAST_TXN_ID low half.

fields.name: LAST_TXN_ID_MIRROR
fields.description: Mirror of the last accepted request transaction ID.

registers.name: COUNTER_LAST_RXN_MIRROR
registers.description: Optional readback mirror of last response transaction ID for software convenience; identical semantics to LAST_RXN_ID low half.

fields.name: LAST_RXN_ID_MIRROR
fields.description: Mirror of the last validated response transaction ID.

registers.name: DIAG_RESPONSE_AGE
registers.description: Current response age in cycles or protocol-defined age units.

fields.name: RESPONSE_AGE
fields.description: Age of the current response candidate or last observed response, in cycles/age units as implemented.

registers.name: DIAG_LIMIT_CHECK
registers.description: Optional diagnostic mirror of programmed limits for software verification.

registers.name: DIAG_TIMEOUTS
registers.description: Optional diagnostic mirror of programmed timeouts.

sources.name: FAULT_STATUS
sources.description: Fault-related status can be polled through STATUS_FAULTS; no interrupt pin is defined in DIGITAL_SPEC_JSON.

init_sequence: Deassert reset and wait for deterministic safe fallback state.
Program TIMEOUT_CYCLES to a nonzero watchdog value.
Program STALE_AGE_LIMIT to the desired freshness threshold.
Program ACTUATOR_MIN and ACTUATOR_MAX to the allowed command window, ensuring min <= max.
Program FALLBACK_COMMAND to the deterministic safe actuator value.
Program CTRL_EN with ENABLE=1 and desired OPERATING_MODE; leave CLEAR_FAULTS cleared unless explicitly clearing sticky faults.
If sticky faults are present and active fault conditions are absent, write CTRL_EN with CLEAR_FAULTS=1 as a write-1 pulse, then re-read STATUS_FAULTS.
polling_sequence: Poll STATUS_FAULTS for FAULT_STATUS, STICKY_FAULT_STATUS, REQUEST_PENDING, WATCHDOG_EXPIRED, CLAMP_ACTIVE, FALLBACK_ACTIVE, and PARSER_ERROR.
Poll LAST_TXN_ID and LAST_RXN_ID to correlate transport activity with software-issued descriptors.
Poll DIAG_RESPONSE_AGE when validating freshness and watchdog behavior.
If REQUEST_PENDING remains asserted beyond TIMEOUT_CYCLES, treat the current transaction as timed out and reinitialize the request path according to system policy.
irq_sequence: No dedicated interrupt line is defined in DIGITAL_SPEC_JSON; software should implement polling or an external wrapper if interrupt aggregation is needed.

consistency_notes: All assumptions remain compatible with DIGITAL_SPEC_JSON.
The register map is abstract and firmware-visible; it does not change top-level hierarchy or ports.
The control-plane width is 32 bits as required by the spec, with 8-bit addressing and compact field packing.
No AXI/APB/I2C bus is forced; the register interface remains abstract/custom as implied by the source-of-truth specification.
